column3: “Devotion” supplies a noun for the relation to Christ.
“I do” supplies the content of God's knowledge.
Devouring and taking are interpreted as exploiting and taking advantage.
“Too weak for that” supplies an explanation; “boast about” is supplied.
Watches and fastings are explained as being without sleep and food.
“With grief” supplies what the burning expresses.
“That show” supplies an explanation of the things of weakness.
